source.quote_free_summary: A team that does not report to the Floor Coordinator on time or answer the calls for a heat is scratched, with the document adding the word disqualified in brackets.

requirement: Same intent as the other UCWDC missed-call rules; the Teams document words it as 'scratched (disqualified)'.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: UCWDC profile. No DanceFlow action, status or workflow models it; the existing 'Excluded (organizer decision)' action (CF1 A5) is organizer policy and is never a substitute.
interpretation_notes: Re-read 2026-11-23: 'will be scratched (disqualified) from that dance category'. The Teams text treats scratch and disqualification as the same outcome, unlike Couples; how DanceFlow's distinct Scratch status maps to it needs an interpretation. BLOCKER for a UCWDC Teams profile.
